blocks.body:
## Skills / Plugins / Apps Package Market Data Insights

`INDEX SCOPE` Universal, CLI, Git, and Apps use different denominators. Click a metric card for exact SQL and reviewed rows.

## ◇ CLI catalog sources

`CATALOG MIX` **180 / 195** rows come from managed curated; bundled and primary runtime are supporting sources.

## ◉ Live mix

`CATALOG MIX` **39.7%** sits in Productivity + Business & Operations; 12 categories hold the remainder.

## ◎ Provider ecosystem

`METADATA COVERAGE` **3,259 third-party plugins · 2,857 providers · 96.5% linked websites.**

## ◎ Third-party category breadth

`CATEGORY × PROVIDER` Productivity leads package count; Business & Operations leads distinct-provider breadth.

## ↗ Provider concentration

`TOP 8` The largest named providers still represent a small share of 2,857 third-party providers, indicating a highly fragmented catalog.

### ↗ Provider metadata links

`PROVIDERS` [Widget · 35](https://www.widget.olutely.com/) · [Spheric Admin Ltd · 29](https://www.widget.olutely.com/) · [Rohas Nagpal · 25](https://github.com/rohasnagpal/legal-ai-skills) · [Yaps AI · 12](https://www.yaps.ai/codex?utm_source=codex&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=official_plugins) · [Layer 3 Labs · 10](https://www.layer3labs.io/) · [Windsor.ai · 5](https://windsor.ai/)

## ◆ Cross-market emphasis

`CATEGORY POSITIONING` Developer Tools over-index in Git; business, finance, and travel over-index in the universal directory.

## ▦ Capability surface

`PACKAGE MIX` **501 skills · 74 App refs · 31 MCP · 47 commands · 23 agents.** Counts overlap.

## ▦ Package capability archetypes

`ARCHITECTURE MIX` **24 Skills only · 16 Skills + Apps + MCP · 11 Apps + MCP.** Together these account for 82.3% of packages.

### ↗ Package metadata links

`SKILLS` [Twilio Developer Kit · 55](https://www.twilio.com/) · [Vercel · 54](https://vercel.com/) · [Life Science Research · 50](https://openai.com/)

`APPS` [Data Analytics · 23](https://openai.com/) · [Public Equity Investing · 15](https://openai.com/) · [Codex Security · 4](https://openai.com/)

`MCP` [Vercel · 1](https://vercel.com/) · [Data Analytics · 1](https://openai.com/) · [Zoom · 1](https://zoom.us/)

## ⌘ Interface map

`SURFACES` **7 CLI · 1 TUI · 18 RPC · 1 notification.**

## ↔ PTY market-source filter

`DIRECTORY FILTER` **3,322 raw App Server rows → −10 CLI-only bundled rows → 3,312 user-visible rows.**

## ◌ Apps / API scope

`APP PACKAGES` **74 references · 54 unique ids · 22 third-party references.** `API SUBSET` **46 / 62 (74.2%).**

query.sql:
-- EXPECTED: 14 rows because the union contains 14 category names across the two market views.
WITH categories AS (
  SELECT category FROM tui_categories
  UNION
  SELECT category FROM repo_categories
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    categories.category,
    COALESCE(tui_categories.count, 0) AS universal_count,
    COALESCE(tui_categories.share, 0.0) AS universal_share,
    COALESCE(repo_categories.count, 0) AS git_count,
    COALESCE(repo_categories.share, 0.0) AS git_share
  FROM categories
  LEFT JOIN tui_categories USING (category)
  LEFT JOIN repo_categories USING (category)
)
SELECT
  category,
  universal_count,
  universal_share,
  git_count,
  git_share,
  git_share - universal_share AS share_delta,
  CASE
    WHEN git_share - universal_share > 0.01 THEN 'Git over-index'
    WHEN git_share - universal_share < -0.01 THEN 'Universal over-index'
    ELSE 'Near parity'
  END AS relative_emphasis
FROM combined
ORDER BY ABS(git_share - universal_share) DESC, category ASC;
query.description: Selects the reviewed category_positioning rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.
metric_definitions: Universal share uses 3,312 TUI-visible plugin rows as its denominator.
Git share uses 62 standard marketplace packages as its denominator.
Relative emphasis compares the two fractional shares at the same category grain.

query.sql:
-- EXPECTED: 62 rows because the official Git marketplace contains 62 package manifests.
SELECT
  name,
  display_name,
  provider,
  provider_scope,
  category,
  url,
  url_source,
  skill_entrypoints,
  app_references,
  mcp_servers,
  command_files,
  agent_files
FROM package_index
ORDER BY skill_entrypoints DESC, app_references DESC, name ASC;
query.description: Selects the reviewed package_index rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.
metric_definitions: Package URLs use interface.websiteURL, then homepage, repository, and author.url.
Provider scope uses manifest developer/author metadata only.

  architecture,
  package_count,
  share,
  openai_packages,

  app_references,

FROM package_archetypes
ORDER BY package_count DESC, architecture ASC;
query.description: Selects the reviewed package_archetypes rows from the normalized audit snapshot.
filters: Point-in-time audit snapshot generated by scripts/collect.mjs.
metric_definitions: Each package belongs to one mutually exclusive archetype based on manifest-declared Skills, Apps, and MCP presence.
Provider and component totals are aggregated within the same 62-package denominator.
